verdict.rationale: Klaviyo offers a documented MCP server for agent connectivity and Composer AI feature that builds audiences from plain-language prompts, plus a programmatic API for segments, suggesting agents could translate descriptions into real segments. However, there's no explicit documentation confirming the MCP server exposes segment-creation as a callable tool or that Composer's audience-building maps directly to the API-created segment objects. missing for 10: explicit MCP tool/endpoint for segment creation, hands-on example of an agent creating a segment via API/MCP, independent corroboration of Composer's audience-to-segment mapping.
